New subs start as 7-day free trials, so today's new subs are next period's App Total Revenue. So expect App Total Revenue to weaken in about 7 days. App Total Revenue is +1.7% right now, so expect that to cool off.

ios.head: App Total New Subs is moving slower than the other steps (-13.1% vs about -3.3%).
ios.body: App Total New Subs is -13.1% while the other steps are all moving about -3.3% — a gap of -9.9pp. When one step moves very differently from the rest, the cause is usually specific to that step.

ios.head: Where installs come from is shifting toward Organic Install (+17.9% vs +1.7% for installs overall).
ios.body: Organic Install (YMK · US) was 957, +17.9% against the average of the same weekday over the past 4 weeks, while total installs moved +1.7% — a difference of +16.2 percentage points. Organic Install is now 26.3% of all installs, so the balance between channels is moving toward it.

ios.head: App Total Revenue +4.2% matches the new subs signed up 7 days earlier.
ios.body: App Total Revenue on 08-31 vs 08-24 is +4.2%, and App Total New Subs on 08-24 vs 08-17 was +5.5% — both moved the same way. Most new subs start as a 7-day free trial, so the revenue landing now mostly comes from people who subscribed about 7 days ago. This is the normal pattern, so no surprise is building up.

insights.title: Market trend — US is losing ground fast on turning installs into subs (-11.2%, now 12.9%).
insights.body: In US, 12.9% of installs now turn into new subs — -11.2% versus last period. It is about 37% of revenue (a big revenue market): fewer of the people downloading are subscribing, and revenue will feel that within a week or two.

insights.title: Revenue vs new subs — App Total Revenue +2.8% does not match new subs -5.5% from 7 days earlier — this growth is not coming from new customers.
insights.body: App Total Revenue on 08-31 vs 08-24 is +2.8%, but App Total New Subs on 08-24 vs 08-17 was -5.5% — they moved in opposite directions. Most new subs start as a 7-day free trial, so the revenue landing now mostly comes from people who subscribed about 7 days ago. Since those subs went the other way, this growth is coming from existing customers instead: check renewals and cancellations, refunds, or a recent price change — not marketing or installs.

insights.title: Installs to subs, by app — YMK is turning installs into New Subs worse than usual (-8.3% vs Install +0.8%).
insights.body: Some apps are not converting installs into subscribers at their usual rate: YMK New Subs -8.3% vs Install +0.8% (worse than its installs). Revenue follows about a week later, so these are the apps to watch next week.

insights.title: Which country — US is out of line with every other country on App Total New Subs (-10.9% vs -4.7%).
insights.body: For All App, App Total New Subs in US is -10.9% while all countries together are -4.7% — a gap of -6.2pp. US is about 37% of revenue, so it is big enough to be worth a look.

insights.title: Best and worst markets — GB turns installs into new subs best of anywhere (25.0% vs 12.3% overall).
insights.body: In GB, 25.0% of installs turn into new subs, versus 12.3% across all markets and apps (+12.7pp difference). That is much better than the rest — worth understanding and copying. GB is about 4% of revenue. Its App Total New Subs is +10.5% this period.

insights.title: Install mix — Where installs come from is shifting toward SEO Install (+6.5% vs -0.8% for installs overall).
insights.body: SEO Install was 2,281, +6.5% against the average of the same weekday over the past 4 weeks, while total installs moved -0.8% — a difference of +7.4 percentage points. SEO Install is now 7.3% of all installs, so the balance between channels is moving toward it.

insights.title: Next period outlook — No big App Total Revenue swing expected in about 7 days — the share of installs that become subs is normal.
insights.body: App Total New Subs is -4.7% and App Total Install is -0.8%; the gap between them (-3.9pp) is under the 10pp we treat as a real signal, so the share of people who install and then subscribe is close to normal. New subs start as 7-day free trials, so today's new subs are next period's App Total Revenue. So nothing unusual is building up that would swing App Total Revenue in about 7 days.

insights.title: Which app — App Total New User is down in every app — something is affecting all of them, not one.
insights.body: App Total New User is down in every app (All App -1.1%, YMK +1.0%, YCP -3.4%, YCV -2.4%). When all apps move together the cause is usually something they share — the season, an app-store change, or how the data is collected — rather than any one app's own doing.
